EmailTemplate.description: A general thank you email to BPLs who hosted a drive.
EmailTemplate.name: Evergreen_General_Thank You
EmailTemplate.subject: Thank you for your partnership!
EmailTemplate.textOnly:
Dear Valued Blood Program Leader,
On behalf of the American Red Cross, we extend our heartfelt gratitude to you for your partnership. By hosting a blood drive, you’ve made a difference in the lives of patients with sickle cell disease, moms with complicated childbirths, people fighting cancer, accident or trauma victims, and more.
Your role as a Blood Program Leader reflects a commitment to helping others and deep sense of community. You are leaving a legacy that directly contributes to the health and wellbeing of individuals in need.
In the coming days, you will receive an email with a brief satisfaction survey. Please complete the survey to help us better serve you and other blood drive partners.
I look forward to partnering with you again on future blood drives. Thank you for your continued support of our lifesaving mission!
Kind regards, [Account Representative Name] [Contact Information]
